title: Sector anti-concentration amplifies a single trial into a partition lower bound

statement.quantifiers: Any finite Hermitian B commuting with orthogonal sector projectors P_m, unit trial psi, tau>0, any sector subset I with q=sum_I p_m>0 and pmax=max_m p_m; p_m=||P_m psi||^2.
statement.assertion: Z_I=Tr_I exp(-tau B) >= (q/pmax) exp[-tau <psi_I,B psi_I>], psi_I=P_I psi/sqrt q. No upper bound on individual sector energies is required. For Poisson-binomial trial number, pmax<=sqrt(pi)/(2sqrt(2V)) with V=sum rho_i(1-rho_i).
assumptions: [B,P_m]=0 gives exact sector orthogonality and energy decomposition.
Jensen applied to each normalized sector and then conditional weights p_m/q.
Poisson-binomial estimate needs independent Bernoulli occupation parameters, not identical ones.

inputs: Analytic trial vector, sector weights/maximum mass and projected energy.
outputs: Trace/partition lower bound; not exact weights or upper asymptotics.
interface.precision: Exact finite sector identities and Fourier bound.
costs: Analytic trial/projection are proof witnesses, not free state preparation.
Physical sector multiplicities and Hilbert-space size remain in full trace.

proof_mechanism: Spectral Jensen within sectors gives exp(-tau E_m).
p_m<=pmax and scalar weighted Jensen yields entropy factor q/pmax.
Fourier characteristic modulus exp[-2V sin²(t/2)] bounds Bernoulli point masses.
When B commutes with chosen projection, removing small probability costs p||B|| rather than sqrt p||B||.
obstructions: A single projected trial alone yields only exp(-tau E), losing sector entropy.
Does not imply exact partition asymptotics or profile mixture weights.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire sector anti-concentration and bounded projected trial energy plus complementary trace control; a lower bound alone is not a number law.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
